page.layout: One page of running text in one column; one marginal note block at the left margin; running head at the top; catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: nescio quæ alia sibi acquisivêre : quam-quam prohibiti ab Ordinibus patriæ uti beneficio Cæsaris non potuerunt. Simul tota regio durante hoc fœdere in summâ quiete & felicitate egit, civitas divitiis, operibus novis, magnificentiâ, amplitudine, ager cultu & nitore crevit, ac fuit summa inter socios animorum & ge-rendæ Reip. conjunctio. Arnoldus Lous Gronin-ga.Hoc tempore, cæso jam ad Nanceium Carolo Burgun-do, Arnoldus Lous Iureconsultus, à Cæsare Friderico ad componendas res per Frisiam Translavicanam missus,con-silii capiendi causâ Groningam deflexit. Eo autore civitas in spem venit perpetuæ potestatis jus in agrum vicinum sibi parandi : paravissetque, & alia quoque adjecisset, quantum in Cæsare erat, si pecuniæ dispendium in loco facere volu-isset. Rediit enim Lous denuò à Cæsare, amplissimis in hanc rem mandatis instru-ctus. Sed illa aulæ cupidine offensa,post-posito consilio hoc, inanem legatum re-misit. Et jam ad exitum penè properabat tempus, quod erat fœderi dictum, ut aut prorogato eodem, aut novato ampliatóve opus

page.notes: The marginal note is set in four short lines ("Arnoldus / Lous / Gronin- / ga.") and is transcribed as one note. "Lous" in the note and in the text is read as printed; it could be "Louis" in the margin, which I could not confirm at this scan resolution. "potuerunt" is read from the print and is a close call. The running head's long s has been normalised to plain s as instructed. The faint stamp at the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
